notes.subject: כשכור
notes.rationale: Hibru i tok 'olsem man i dring' — Tok Pisin 'taem' i min dringman, lain ol i save wokabaut no stret

notes.subject: ימששו
notes.rationale: Man i save painim rot wantaim han long daik; o 'ol i save filim daik' — wok bilong mashash em i wok bilong han

translation: Ol i save painim rot long taim bilong daik, na ⟨i no gat⟩ lait; na em i salim ol i wokabaut olsem man i dring taem ol i go ausait.

tokens.gloss: na em i salim ol i wokabaut olsem man i dring
